mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% indicates labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL above 190 and FEDFUNDS above 2.0 signals inflation without policy accommodation, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 190 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDP growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5.0%), housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 units signal weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:late-cycle expansion defined by GDP growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) above 115 indicates strong manufacturing output, correlating with improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 115.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 2000 units signals housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000.

mechanism_narrative: Joint PAYEMS growth above 132000 and RSAFS growth above 340000 signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 132000 and RSAFS > 340000.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS above 2.5% signals aggressive rate policy, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations for negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% in a monetary tightening cycle.
